resolution_policy.candidate_order: provisional; require semantic eligibility before priority
resolution_policy.conflicting_eligible_candidates: return null with ambiguous status unless an approved override selects one
resolution_policy.signs: Normalize using source-specific reviewed sign transforms; never apply abs() blindly.
resolution_policy.scope: Consolidated issuer totals only; reject segment/geographic/component facts as substitutes.
resolution_policy.filings: Default latest available restatement; optional as_of restricts acceptance timestamps to the cutoff. Every selected fact retains its own accession.
resolution_policy.periods: Resolve exact start/end dates. Do not treat fp/fy as the observation period without checking dates.
resolution_policy.quarter_derivation: Difference compatible YTD duration amounts only; Q4 may use FY minus nine-month YTD. Never difference EPS or weighted-average shares; do not difference mismatched restatement vintages.

source_types.mapped_node: Direct rules default to node_id/concept in the original industry IS.
source_types.raw_concept: Explicit supplemental concept with source_status review; not an approved industry mapping.
source_types.resolved_metric: Reference to another resolved API metric; never interpret as a raw fact node.

operations.sum: Add all inputs in order after sign normalization.
operations.subtract: Subtract each subsequent input from the first input in order.

rule_contract.eligibility: Rule conditions and source semantics must be checked before priority. Anomalies retain flags and provenance; no unconditional first-non-null selection.
rule_contract.priority: Ascending unique integer within each metric/profile. Direct rules precede fallback calculations.
rule_contract.unsupported: No configured compatible rule; distinct from company-level confirmed not-applicable.
rule_contract.expression: Human-readable mirror of operation and ordered inputs, not executable code.
rule_contract.execution_scope: db.build_api_results supports exact FY and standalone Q1–Q4 periods; annual is an FY input alias. Direct, sum, subtract, resolved_metric dependencies and signs require fact-pinned approvals. Monetary duration quarter fallbacks subtract compatible YTD inputs only, with additional period approval and full provenance. EPS, weighted-average shares and instant balances are never differenced. db.read_api_results accepts Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4/FY/annual/quarter selectors.
